newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese threatened by park rides, cosmetics - survey.
newsitem.headline: Chinese threatened by park rides, cosmetics - survey.

text.p: Chinese consumers, plagued for decades by shoddy and even dangerous products, have most to fear from amusement park rides and cosmetics, the Workers' Daily said on Thursday.

A survey by the State Bureau of Technical Supervision of various goods between July and September found that an average of nearly 22 percent of all kinds of consumer products surveyed had not met quality standards, it said.
"Those with the most outstanding problems were large-scale rides in amusement parks and cosmetics found in beauty and hair Salons," the newspaper said.
The bureau had surveyed 26 amusement parks, finding about 58 percent of the rides were not up to standard, it said.
More than two-thirds of the cosmetic products surveyed in beauty salons were found to violate labelling and health standards, it said.
The survey also found that about 35 percent of safety products such as safety nets and safety belts were below standard, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
